subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a battle-hardened agent of the Earth Temple who led the assault on ghouls and ghasts, detected approaching undead, and maintained cover while clearing the dungeon.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa is a determined warrior of the Earth Temple who improved in combat effectiveness, eliminated multiple undead, and worked in concert with allies to secure the dungeon.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a vengeful operative of the Earth Temple who revived after near-death, delivered decisive kills with daggers and pistol, and declared territorial conquest to maintain cover.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a resilient cleric of the Earth Temple who restored his strength through healing, summoned spectral guardians repeatedly, endured poison and paralyzing touches, and led tactical engagements against undead.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is a covert organization claiming territory within enemy strongholds, using espionage and sabotage; the party acts as its agents, expanding influence under false pretenses.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag is an authority with whom the party must negotiate to officially claim newly cleared dungeon territory, indicating a hierarchy or governing body within the temple's structure.

subject: ghouls
fact: Over twenty ghouls were slain in two engagements; they attacked with deadly efficiency, wounded key party members, and were ultimately eliminated by coordinated strikes.

subject: ghasts
fact: Two ghasts were encountered and slain; they emitted poisonous stenches, used paralyzing touches, and threatened the party with declarations of consumption before being destroyed by spectral guardians and gunfire.

subject: giant snake
fact: A giant snake was slain during the dungeon clearance; its corpse was among the remains marking the party's victory, though its role in the battle was not detailed.

subject: dungeon clearance
fact: The party successfully cleared an entire dungeon section of undead threats, including over twenty ghouls, two ghasts, and a giant snake, establishing control under the guise of territorial expansion for the Earth Temple.

subject: spectral guardians deployment
fact: Calmer invoked spectral guardians three times during the battle; each use tore through undead ranks, forced retreats, and ultimately proved decisive against ghasts despite personal cost.

subject: ghast chamber
fact: The ghast chamber was a fortified area within the dungeon where the final confrontation occurred; it was entered after pre-casting defenses, and its doorway was the site of hostile declarations and lethal magic.

subject: pistol
fact: Zephyr’s pistol was fired once, delivering the final blow to the last ghast; its echo marked the end of the battle and demonstrated the party’s access to rare, non-magical weaponry.

subject: territorial claim
fact: The party must negotiate with Romag to officially claim the cleared dungeon territory, indicating an unresolved political requirement beneath their apparent success.

subject: monster recruitment
fact: The party learned that holding ground is insufficient; they must recruit monsters to populate and defend their new domain, setting up a future mission objective.

subject: espionage cover
fact: The party maintains the appearance of serving the Earth Temple’s expansion while likely operating under deeper, unspoken directives — their true allegiance and mission remain obscured.

subject: session end
fact: The battle concluded with the party victorious, marking the end of this mission phase and positioning them as formidable agents within the enemy stronghold.
